draft_key_information_units.information: The Group reported a 2.6% decrease in consolidated revenue to 919.6 million euros in 2025 (from 944.6 million euros in 2024), with net profit declining 36.2% to 17.5 million euros (from 27.5 million euros in 2024). Profit before tax fell 31.4% to 24.3 million euros.

The car trade segment experienced an 11.9% revenue decline to 176.9 million euros due to the Estonian motor vehicle tax, which caused a 48.6% drop in new passenger car sales in Estonia; this was partially offset by stable performance in Latvian and Lithuanian subsidiaries.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, 2025 overview and Car segment section (pages 20-21)

draft_key_information_units.information: The supermarket segment increased revenue by 0.3% to 611.9 million euros but net profit fell 38.6% to 9.5 million euros, driven by economic weakness, promotional pricing pressure, and one-off costs from store refurbishments; strategic investments included logistics center optimization and assortment expansion.

The department stores segment recorded a 1.1% revenue decline to 103.0 million euros and a net loss of 0.5 million euros, affected by warmer winter conditions; strategic actions included refurbishment of Kaubamaja Children’s World and launch of the Anni Arro café, with e-shop upgrades planned for 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Department stores segment section (page 19)

draft_key_information_units.information: The real estate segment increased revenue by 5.1% to 7.7 million euros but profit before tax fell 18.4% to 9.0 million euros, primarily due to one-off gains in 2024; rental income from the newly operational logistics center offset declines from prior-year property sales.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Real Estate segment section (page 21)

draft_key_information_units.information: Cash and cash equivalents decreased to 29.5 million euros (from 45.5 million euros in 2024), with working capital turning negative at 14.2 million euros; management confirms strong operating cash flow mitigates liquidity risk despite short-term loan maturities in 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial risks section and Consolidated Cash Flow Statement (pages 15, 91)

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic expansion in the car segment includes the January 2026 agreement to acquire Rohe Auto AS and SKO Motors OÜ (Škoda distribution rights) in Estonia, enhancing brand portfolio and dealership network; 2025 also saw new multi-brand showrooms in Vilnius and ongoing bodywork workshop construction in Peetri.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Chairman of the Management Board’s Statement and Events after the reporting period (pages 6, 10)

draft_key_information_units.information: Major operational developments include refurbishment of Jögeva Selver, Kaubamaja Children’s World, and Peetri KIA dealership; energy-efficient CO₂ refrigeration systems at Jögeva Selver; completion of Lithuania’s multi-brand car centre; and digital upgrades to e-shops, Partner Card platforms, and D365 business software.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 overview key events and Strategy section (pages 11, 22)

draft_key_information_units.information: The Management Board proposes a dividend payment of 0.60 euros per share (24.4 million euros total) from 2025 retained earnings, with associated income tax expense of 6.7 million euros.

evaluation.selection_rationale: The draft units prioritize headline financial metrics (D1), major segment performance drivers and changes (D2-D5), liquidity position (D6), key strategic expansions (D7), significant operational investments (D8), and profit allocation (D9). Units D1, D3, D4, D5, and D9 align with reference summary salience, while D2, D6, D7, and D8 cover critical context not exhaustive in the reference but material for comprehensive summary coverage. The selection balances financial outcomes, performance drivers, strategic actions, and post-period events within the 6-10 unit target.
